title: Pages Navigation Sidebar On Type Change
description: Clicking on a tree navigation item such as tree/flat/toc should "show navigation" and when in focused reading, it in pages should unfocus it and open the sidebar

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed by resetting the Pages UI state key and no longer restoring nav visibility from storage, so existing hidden-navigation preferences no longer collapse the sidebar by default or race with the toggle. Tree/Flat/ToC buttons now force navigation visible and exit focus mode, the reset-view-state commandbar button is removed, the Pages search action is an icon button beside the search box, and the hidden-nav mobile grid lets the selected page fill the available height. Validation: focused Pages route/navigation-freeze tests and build passed.
